fit: Compiles multi-agent roles into prompt skills within a single LLM call, linking reusable skills to coordination/context repetition costs.
evidence: Table 3: average 53.7% token and 49.5% latency reductions across GSM8K, HumanEval and HotpotQA; three/four calls collapse to one.
limitations: Preliminary reasoning benchmarks and synthetic skill-selection libraries; not a long-horizon realistic tool-workflow comparison. Token accounting less explicit than BenchAgent; no measured peak-context trace.
